subject: Re: SafelyYou - Encord | Great meeting you at CVPR
text:
Hi Kat,

Thanks for setting up some time on Thursday, I'm looking forward to
discussing how Encord may be a good fit for our annotation needs.

As a reminder from our conversation, we use Voxel51 for data curation, and
we have high-volume sets for both still images and videos. We would like to
continue using Voxel51 for our curation needs, but we're open to other
options for the data annotation itself. Current annotation tasks include
object detection, human pose estimation (2D keypoints), and person
tracking, but we're expanding into other tasks such as Re-Identification
and spatio-temporal action recognition.

See you on Thursday!
Abel
